# AGENTS.md quality rubric

Criteria marked ▣ are enforced mechanically by `agentsdir check`; the
others belong to the critique pass (step 4).

## ▣ Mechanical — check fails on these

- ▣ AGENTS.md exists — `check` fails on a repo without it (run
  `agentsdir init`).
- ▣ The `rules-index` managed block is present and lists exactly the
  rules on disk — regenerated by `sync`, never edited by hand.
- ▣ The CLAUDE.md projection matches AGENTS.md (symlink, or copy kept
  in step by `sync`) — any divergence is reported as projection drift.

## Critique pass

- Three families kept: generic sections, stack sections, product
  sections.
- Exact commands (build, targeted test, lint) with the explicit
  never-run commands (watch, deploy) — the non-guessable first.
- Only what diverges from the ecosystem defaults: the model already
  knows the standards.
- Nothing that a linter, the CI or a hook already enforces mechanically.
- No duplication with README or docs: pointers, never copies.
- Existing agent configs imported, never overwritten.
- Short: every line passes the filter
  question: "if this line is deleted, will the agent make a mistake?"
  A false line is worse than no file.
